_doc: DERIVED from savannah-2313.png through tools/savannah-2313-extract.py, using the registration in savannah-2313-georef.json. Heart, the capital, drawn as a small outline rather than as a division - and the six radiation trefoils of the western defence line. The registration recorded 'no point sites at all'; these are the correction.
eraNote: EVERY feature is dated 2313. Misfits' present is about 2302, so this sheet is ELEVEN YEARS AHEAD of it. Owner's ruling: use it as-is to describe the south-east in more detail, mutating where it disagrees - not as a dated observation to be projected.
publication: REPOSITORY MATERIAL ONLY. The sheet carries no printed licence, so nothing derived from it is published until the owner rules. A creator name is not a licence.

boundaryExclusion.where: Louisiana marsh and Mississippi delta, lon -91.0 to -88.8, lat 28.9 to 30.5
boundaryExclusion.why: Holds 207 of the 214 points worse than 15 km and every point worse than 20 km, including the 33.8 km worst case. Both directions fail here at once -- the sheet draws land where there is water and omits Lake Pontchartrain, Lake Borgne, Mississippi Sound and the delta birdfoot -- which is the signature of a simplified trace, not a registration error.

properties.name: Heart
properties.note: Drawn as a small outlined blob at the junction of four spheres, about 41 x 28 px - a CITY, not a sixth division. The author: the capital was relocated here in the late 2290s to a 'newly founded' city, with their own footnote 'Original residents displaced'.
properties.positionSource: mechanical - centroid of the outline the sheet draws

properties.note: The sheet prints one three-line label beside a north-south line of radiation trefoils on the state's western flank, facing the dissidents. The individual markers are not named and none is invented here.
